Tactical backpack

  • Reliable and durable material: 18.5 x 11.5 x 7.5 inches, capacity: 25L . 19.5 x 12.5 x 8.5 inches, capacity: 26L.The backpack is made of 900D high-density fabric, which is durable.

Tactical backpack

Product size is 18.5 x 11.5 x 7.5 inches. capacity: 25L . 19.5 x 12.5 x 8.5 inches, capacity: 26L.The shock bag backpack is designed with double needle heavy zipper and practical pull cord, side and front load compression system, and the shoulder belt is made of breathable mesh cushion, which is breathable and comfortable. This tactical bag backpack can be used as a 3-day bag, army backpack, range backpack, hunting backpack, survival backpack, hiking backpack and daily backpack. Note: this military backpack does not include a hydrating bladder.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
